acceptance: Context records the issue_comment edited or deleted gate run ID; that it ran develop's workflow code; and the oracle-gate status it posted, with timestamps after the edit or deletion. That status is failure if the stand-in was the only basis for success, and unchanged otherwise.
Or context records the owner's decision not to run the live check, with its date.
context: Found 2026-10-25: the stand-in edit/delete item merged in #3430 with no live check, and the post-cutover live verification recorded the path as not exercisable without the owner. Blocked on owner action.
description:
Problem: #3430 made oracle-gate re-run on issue_comment edited and deleted events, so that withdrawing an accepted stand-in removes a gate success. Unit tests cover the decision. No live run has exercised the trigger, because only the owner can post a stand-in.

Outcome: one recorded live observation, or a recorded decision to rely on the unit tests.

Decision gates:
1. Owner action only. Agents never post, edit or delete stand-ins. Ask the owner, next time a real stand-in is needed or on a throwaway PR the owner chooses, to edit or delete it after the gate passes. If the owner declines, record that and finish on the unit-test evidence.
2. Withdrawing evidence. Following docs/agent/merge-authority.md, the PR stays unarmed before the stand-in is withdrawn.

Common guardrails: no stand-in approvals by agents, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests.
